nourished.screen.diet.tip: Try to keep your diet balanced by eating a variety of foods.
nourished.toast.critical.title: %s critically low!
nourished.toast.critical.subtitle: Eat more %s foods
config.nourished.title: Nourished Config
config.nourished.decayRate.desc: How much nutrient value decays per decay cycle.
config.nourished.decayIntervalTicks.desc: Ticks between each nutrient decay cycle.
config.nourished.enableHUD.desc: Shows the compact nutrient HUD while you play (when no menu is open).
config.nourished.hudAnchor.desc: Which screen corner the HUD is anchored to before applying pixel offsets.
config.nourished.hudOffsetX.desc: Horizontal shift from the anchor corner. Dragging the HUD in-game updates this.
config.nourished.hudOffsetY.desc: Vertical shift from the anchor corner. Dragging the HUD in-game updates this.
config.nourished.hudBarWidth.desc: Width of each nutrient bar on the HUD.
config.nourished.hudScale.desc: Scales bar width, labels, and padding together.
config.nourished.hudReservedBottom.desc: Space reserved above the hotbar when using a bottom anchor (pixels).
config.nourished.hudDraggable.desc: When enabled, click and drag the HUD panel in-game to reposition it (offsets are saved).
config.nourished.dietBarDragEnabled.desc: When enabled, drag nutrient icons on the Diet screen to reorder rows. Order is saved for next time.
config.nourished.criticalThreshold.desc: Below this value nutrients are critical (red).
config.nourished.lowThreshold.desc: Below this value nutrients are low (orange).
config.nourished.excessThreshold.desc: Above this value nutrients are considered excess.
config.nourished.bonusEffectThreshold.de: All macros above this value can trigger bonus effects.
Any macro below this value can trigger penalty effects.
config.nourished.hudEditHotkey.desc: Press this key in-game to enter HUD edit mode.
